name: Ringo Starr
description: Ringo Starr in the 1965 Beatles cartoon style, with his large pear-shaped nose and blue suit.
character_notes: Ringo Starr 1965 Beatles cartoon. HUGE pear-shaped projecting nose, tiny chin, droopy expressive eyes, black mop hair and flared nape tufts, shorter slim body. Blue jacket and matching blue trousers, dark navy turtleneck, black shoes. Preserve original mature cartoon proportions; no drum, sticks or new props. Flat cel-cartoon colors and crisp black outlines, exact source identity. Head pitch/yaw for looks with anchored frontal torso and feet.
visual_generation: built-in imagegen; each state grounded in canonical identity and source references

running_left.method: framewise horizontal mirror of approved running-right frames; temporal order preserved
running_left.reason: no handed props or asymmetric costume markings in selected design

workflow_notes: Generate canonical base first from both identity references.
Generate each action independently; extract complete pose components with one shared scale per row.
Reserve jump headroom and retain airborne vertical displacement.
Approve standard-row contact sheet, then four cardinal anchors, then coherent look row9, then row10.
Use look-mechanics.md and cardinal anchors for direction meaning; prior look row supplies scale and continuity.
